There's nothing like the good old-fashioned humor of noisy bodily functions! A burp may seem like a simple thing: just air being expelled from the stomach through your mouth. But the complexity of burping comes from the wide variety of burp techniques and sounds that are possible. Most people have been practicing their burping skills since they were babies being patted on the back over their mommy's shoulder. But it takes true dedication to really advance and perfect your burping. Once you learn the basic burp, you can move on to louder, more impressive burps that can really be used to show off. Whether its a deep prolonged beer burp or a precise burp recitation of the alphabet, belching is humor in its purest form!

With this app, you'll gain access to endless immature humor featuring high quality burp sounds that you can use to impress (or annoy) your friends!
